name: Google Ads - BB Customer Match List

parameters.query:
WITH KundenDaten AS
(
    SELECT
        a.cMail AS EmailAdresse,
        a.cVorname AS Vorname,
        a.cName AS Nachname,
        a.cLand AS Land,
        a.cPLZ AS Postleitzahl,
        a.cTel AS Telefonnummer,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY a.cMail
            ORDER BY a.cTel
        ) AS rn
    FROM dbo.tAdresse AS a
    WHERE a.cMail IS NOT NULL
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(a.cMail)) <> ''
      AND EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.tBestellung AS b
          WHERE b.tKunde_kKunde = a.kKunde
            AND b.cBestellNr NOT LIKE 'LEAF-%'
            AND b.cBestellNr NOT LIKE 'CINNA-%'
            AND b.cBestellNr NOT LIKE 'A-%'
      )
)
SELECT
    EmailAdresse,
    Vorname,
    Nachname,
    Land,
    Postleitzahl,
    Telefonnummer
FROM KundenDaten
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY EmailAdresse;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  user_email as Email,
  MAX(CASE WHEN meta_key = 'billing_first_name' THEN meta_value END) as 'First Name',
  MAX(CASE WHEN meta_key = 'billing_last_name' THEN meta_value END) as 'Last Name',
  MAX(CASE WHEN meta_key = 'billing_country' THEN meta_value END) as 'Country',
  MAX(CASE WHEN meta_key = 'billing_postcode' THEN meta_value END) as 'Zip',
  MAX(CASE WHEN meta_key = 'billing_phone' THEN meta_value END) as 'Phone'
FROM d034ee28.wp_users users
JOIN wp_usermeta ON users.ID = wp_usermeta.user_id
WHERE users.user_status = 0
GROUP BY users.id;
